data.name: Rakesh
data.gender_notes: Rakesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of the full moon; the moon
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rakā, 'full moon', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the full moon'. Its root is Sanskrit rakā + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name for the moon. Rakesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the full moon; the moon”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rakesh expresses “Lord of the full moon; the moon”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit rakā, 'full moon', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the full moon'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakesh total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: From which word is Rakesh derived?
faq.a: From the Sanskrit rakā, 'full moon', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the full moon'.

faq.q: Is Rakesh mentioned in scripture or history?
faq.a: A classical Sanskrit name for the moon.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for Rakesh?
faq.a: A classical Sanskrit name for the moon.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Rakesh?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Rakesh is 8 (ruling planet Saturn). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Rakesh?
faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for Rakesh. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Rakesh?
faq.a: Blue Sapphire is the traditional association for Rakesh. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Rakesh?
faq.a: Blue, Black are the traditional associations for Rakesh. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Rakesh?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakesh total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Rakesh?
faq.a: The meaning of Rakesh carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Rakesh have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Rakesh is recorded as a hindu name meaning “Lord of the full moon; the moon”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Rakesh?
faq.a: In English, Rakesh is rendered as “Lord of the full moon; the moon”.

faq.q: Is Rakesh suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Rakesh is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
